Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 22-Nov-2024 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
 THIRD SEMESTER B.TECH. (COMPUTER SCIENCE & ENGINEERING) EXAMINATION - NOVEMBER / DECEMBER 2024  
  SUBJECT: CSE 2124/CSE_2124 - OBJECT ORIENTED PROGRAMMING  
  OBJECT ORIENTED PROGRAMMING [CSE 2124]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                      Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               Write a simple Java program for the Weather Monitoring System. The system should enable users             (3)  
  to add weather data, including temperature, humidity for different cities identified by unique IDs.  
  Users should be able to view the weather details for all recorded locations, update the weather  
  data. Additionally, the system should alert users if the temperature exceeds a specified threshold.  
  Use the switch case to do the operations.  
1B)               Demonstrate a Java program for the Vaccination Tracking System to manage individuals'                     (4)  
  vaccination statuses by collecting essential details such as name, ID, severe allergy status (as a  
  boolean), and the date of the last vaccination. The system checks everyone's eligibility for the next  
  vaccination based on two criteria: they must not have severe allergies and must have waited at  
  least six months since their last vaccination. The program uses an array of vaccine objects to store  
  and process this information efficiently, providing a structured way to track vaccinations.  
1C)               Write a program that accepts a string (with all alphabets in lower-case) as a command-line                (3)  
  argument. Display this string along with its length on the console. Identify any vowel(s) in the string  
  and convert it to upper case without making use of any in-built functions. Also, display the final  
  converted string back on the console.  
2A)               Write a Java program using inheritance and interfaces to design a Payment Processing System for (5)  
  an e-commerce platform that supports multiple payment methods such as Credit Cards and PayPal.  
  The system also needs to handle transaction logging and user notifications.  
  
  All payment methods share common functionalities like payment validation and refunds.  
  Different payment methods should have their own specific ways to process payments.  
  Logging and notification should be optional features, as not all payment methods require  
  these functionalities  
  
  
  Provide code examples to demonstrate how inheritance is used for general payment processing and  
  how interfaces are applied for optional features like logging and notifications.  
2B)               Write a generic method to swap any two values of any type of data and display the values after            (3)  
  swapping. With suitable examples illustrate generic restrictions on arrays.  
2C)               Assume that you are tasked to develop a library system where different classes reside in separate         (2)  
  packages. In the package library.books, a class Book is defined with the following attributes:title  
  (public), author (protected), isbn (default), and price (private). Another package library.users  
  contains a class Member that needs to access the Book class attributes and print their values.  
  
  1) Explain which attributes of the Book class can be accessed directly in the Member class and  
  why.  
  2) Write a code snippet to demonstrate how the Member class in the library.users package can  
  access the accessible attributes of the Book class.  
  
  Page 1 of 4

3A)       Create a class Book that encapsulates book details - ISBN and genre of a book at a library. The           (3)  
  different genres that the library offers for its readers is stored in a string array, genres which is a  
  variable within IGenre interface. Create a class BookDemo with main() that initializes an array of  
  Book objects. All the books must be checked if they can be procured from library or not through  
  checkGenre(Book[] b) of Book. A book cannot be procured if its specified genre is not in genres  
  array. Handle this scenario by throwing GenreUnavailableException that displays a suitable  
  message such as "Genre: Sci-Fi of Book:103 not available".  
3B)       Build a Java program that uses Runnable Interface with the following functionality: The 1D array      (5)  
  (size of the array be a square number, ex: 9, 16, 25 etc) is taken from the user in main (). Create  
  one child thread to sort the elements and another child thread to create the 2D array (square matrix)  
  from the sorted array. Display the size of the matrix in the main ().  
3C)       Write a Java program that demonstrates thread communication between two threads using wait()              (2)  
  and notify() to display the number and its square alternately. Consider numbers from 1 to 10.  
4A)       Develop a generic class Pair< T, U> that can store two elements of any type, one of typeT and the (3)  
  other of type U. Implement the following functionalities:  
  a) A constructor to initialize the two elements.  
  b) Methods to retrieve the first element (getFirst()) and the second element (getSecond()).  
  c) Methods to update the values of the first element (setFirst()) and the second element  
  (setSecond()).  
  d) A static generic method swap() that accepts two Pair objects of the same type and swaps their  
  values.  
4B)       Build a java program using thread synchronization concept based on this scenario. Indian railway (5)  
  wants to develop an application to book 1 AC tickets for the travellers whose total count is 10.  
  Consider that you have been assigned to develop the module for ticket booking wherein you are  
  required to create 3 threads using the class named ACTRAINBOOKING by extending the Thread  
  class. Further inside the run method call the method booking method which is used to book the  
  seats and display appropriate message about the status of booking. (if tickets are not available  
  display message and do not book it). This method booking is defined inside another class named  
  bookseat which has instance variable named count whose value is assigned to 10 which  
  represents the number of seats.  
4C)   Given the following code snippets, determine if each one is compliant or noncompliant with secure coding (2)  
  practices. For noncompliant code, provide a compliant solution. Also Define the relevant CERT Oracle  
  Secure Coding Standard for Java rule.
